name: Architectural Decision Record (ADR)
axiom: Record the options you rejected; the decision will be re-litigated without them.
trigger: Architecture council submissions and technical governance, where a later engineer will ask why this way.

steps.text: Title and status: what was decided and whether it holds.
Context: the constraints that made a choice necessary.
Options: each with its trade-off named.
Decision: the one chosen, and by whom.
Consequences: what it costs, and how it would be reversed.

antiPattern.violation: A record that states the decision and omits the alternatives, so the next team treats it as arbitrary and reopens it.
antiPattern.remediation: Name two rejected options with their reasons. The record is for the person who inherits it.

parametricParams.caption: THE REJECTED OPTIONS ARE THE RECORD
